timeline.summary: Heineken N.V. reported Q4 FY26 trading update for Indian operations with low-single-digit net revenue growth and mid-single-digit total volume growth.
United Breweries received a favourable order from the GST Commissioner (Appeals) in Bihar, reducing a tax penalty to ₹1.86 lakh.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,408.41 Cr (-0.4% YoY), net profit ₹101.87 Cr (+4.2% YoY).
United Breweries released Q4 FY26 investor presentation highlighting a 3% decline in net sales and a 16% jump in premium volumes.
Nikhil Malpani, CFO, shared the audio recording of the Q4 FY2026 earnings call via the provided weblink on May 7, 2026.
United Breweries reported an inadvertent disclosure of draft annual financial results to an outside individual on May 5, 2026.
United Breweries submitted the transcript of its Q4 FY26 earnings call held on May 6, 2026.
United Breweries announced on May 12, 2026, that the Maharashtra Sales Tax Tribunal ruled in its favour, reducing the disputed FY19 CST demand of ₹275 Cr to NIL.
United Breweries announced the closure of its Ludhiana brewery unit effective June 30, 2026, entering a long-term contract brewing lease for Punjab and Delhi supplies.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,623.01 Cr (+23.7% YoY), net profit ₹134.81 Cr (+190.9% YoY).
United Breweries Limited invites Q2FY2027 Earnings Call on October 28, 2026.
United Breweries Limited made the audio recording of its earnings call for quarter ended September 30, 2026 available on its website on October 28, 2026.
